```yaml
name: Deploy Lexical Search Worker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

      - name: Cache pnpm store
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.pnpm-store
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm --filter lexical-search-worker test

      - name: Run typecheck
        run: pnpm --filter lexical-search-worker typecheck

      - name: Run lint
        run: pnpm --filter lexical-search-worker lint

      - name: Build worker
        run: pnpm --filter lexical-search-worker build

      - name: Sync lexical artifacts
        run: pnpm --filter lexical-search-worker sync
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          D1_DATABASE_ID: ${{ secrets.D1_DATABASE_ID }}
          R2_BUCKET_ID: ${{ secrets.R2_BUCKET_ID }}

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          workingDirectory: services/lexical-search-worker
          command: publish
        env:
          D1_DATABASE_ID: ${{ secrets.D1_DATABASE_ID }}
          R2_BUCKET_ID: ${{ secrets.R2_BUCKET_ID }}
```
